```plato
    // Chamfered intersection; bounds are the intersection of the operands grown by
    // width. Precondition: width is positive.
    ChamferIntersection(a: BoundedSdf2D, b: BoundedSdf2D, width: Number): BoundedSdf2D
        => (
            a.Sdf.ChamferIntersection(b.Sdf, width),
            GrowBounds(IntersectionOfBounds(a.Bounds, b.Bounds), width));
```
